title: South Africa Lion:
title_q: “Families Have Good Days, They Have Bad Days”
title_short: South Africa Lion · Good Days, Bad Days
headline: A South African Lion explains why Lions become family, through good days and bad days, and leaves with a new friend.
story: A Lion from South Africa in a yellow Lions polo is “definitely happy”. Atdhe asks if anyone in his club is like family. Yes: with one common purpose, Lions naturally become family, and families have good days and bad days. His advice for a first convention: meet Lions from other countries, you learn so much from other people.
The button is real and funny: Atdhe asks if he can say he has a friend in South Africa now. “You definitely have a friend in South Africa, obviously.” Warm, honest, light.
